item.title: 【BLU-RAY】BLU-RAY - Richard Wagner - Die Walkure [4K Ultra HD Blu-ray] (2017) 2160p
item.description:
Richard Wagner - Die Walkure [4K Ultra HD Blu-ray] (2017) 2160p



Die Walküre is presented on 4K UHD courtesy of Unitel and C Major with a 2160p transfer in 1.78:1.
“Re-creation” of Karajan’s musico-theatrical vision of the masterwork, with which the legendary Maestro opened the very first Easter Festival in 1967.
On the occasion of its 50th anniversary, the Salzburg Easter Festival presents a “Re-creation” of Die Walküre: of Herbert von Karajan’s musico-theatrical vision of the 19th century masterwork.
The top-ranking ensemble of singers performs in the faithfully reconstructed scenery of the original production with impressive video backdrops inspired by the original glass paintings.
